# Hook: validate-before-handoff

Ensure the baseline and the Product Change overlay validate before a handoff is generated.

GitHub Copilot has no hook runtime, so this guard is documentation: run the commands
below yourself (or in CI) at the described moments.

## before-handoff-generation

```bash
product-definition validate
```

```bash
product-definition change validate ${change}
```

A handoff generated from an invalid overlay would package broken product knowledge; this hook blocks on deterministic failure.
